result.instructions: Tools for Beyond Pricing, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my listings have price syncing turned off?"; "Show the calendar and nightly prices for my beach apartment for the next 30 days."; "Compare my occupancy last month with the neighborhood benchmark.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Beyond Pricing data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run beyondpricing_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run beyondpricing_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run beyondpricing_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. beyondpricing_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: beyondpricing_list_listings
tools.title: List listings
tools.description: List the listings Beyond prices for this account: title, market, bedrooms, base and minimum price, price-syncing state and health score. Start here to find a listing id. A listing appears only with at least one active channel listing. GET /api/v1/listings/.

enabled.description: Only listings with price syncing on (true) or off (false).

name.description: Only listings whose title contains this text.

market.description: Only listings in this Beyond market, for example 'San Francisco'.

bedrooms.description: Only listings with exactly this bedroom count.

in_active_market.description: Only listings fully priceable (true) or not (false).

tools.name: beyondpricing_get_listing
tools.title: Get a listing
tools.description: Get one listing with all its attributes, including base price, minimum and maximum price, minimum stay, the sync status and the pricing-readiness flag. GET /api/v1/listings/{id}/.

tools.name: beyondpricing_get_calendar
tools.title: Get a listing calendar
tools.description: Get the daily calendar of one listing for a date range: nightly price, availability and the pricing factors behind each night. Prices are in the listing's currency. Defaults: from today to 365 days ahead. GET /api/v1/listings/{id}/calendar/.

start_date.description: First date (default today in the listing's timezone).

end_date.description: Last date (default today + 365 days). Must not be before start_date.

tools.name: beyondpricing_get_market_insights
tools.title: Get market insights
tools.description: Compare one listing's daily performance (occupancy, revenue per night, rates) with its neighborhood benchmark over a date range (up to 731 days). GET /api/v1/listings/{id}/market-insights/.

start_date.description: First stay date (default 1 January of this year).

end_date.description: Last stay date (default 31 December of this year).

tools.name: beyondpricing_list_recommendations
tools.title: List base-price recommendations
tools.description: List Beyond's base-price recommendations for one listing, newest first, with whether each is pending, approved, rejected, expired or applied automatically. GET /api/v1/listings/{id}/recommendations/.

tools.name: beyondpricing_list_change_history
tools.title: List listing change history
tools.description: List who changed a listing's pricing settings, what changed and when, newest first. Use it to explain a price change. GET /api/v1/listings/{id}/change-history/.

changed_after.description: Only changes at or after this ISO 8601 time, for example 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

changed_before.description: Only changes at or before this ISO 8601 time.

tools.name: beyondpricing_get_customizations
tools.title: Get all pricing rules of a listing
tools.description: Get every pricing customization of one listing in one response: base price, minimum stays, min/max prices, extra guest fees, time-based adjustments, manual overrides, occupancy-based pricing, check-in/out days and gap price adjustments. GET /api/v1/listings/{id}/customizations/.

annotations.title: Get all pricing rules of a listing

tools.name: beyondpricing_get_customization
tools.title: Get one pricing rule of a listing
tools.description: Get one pricing customization of a listing by type, for example base-price, min-stays or min-max-prices. GET /api/v1/listings/{id}/customizations/{type}/.

annotations.title: Get one pricing rule of a listing

tools.name: beyondpricing_list_compsets
tools.title: List comp sets
tools.description: List the comp sets (groups of comparable listings) you can see: kind, title, listing id and member count. Use it to pick one to read in detail. GET /api/v1/compsets/.

kind.description: Only custom or only connected comp sets.

listing_id.description: Only comp sets of this listing id.

tools.name: beyondpricing_get_compset
tools.title: Get a comp set
tools.description: Get one comp set in full: its member listings, metrics and enrichment. GET /api/v1/compsets/{id}/.

tools.name: beyondpricing_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations of your listings. By default: stays that check out from today on, all statuses. Filter by listing, check-in window, status or booking date. GET /api/v1/reservations/.

listing_ids.description: Listing ids to include (at most 100). Default: every listing the token can see.

start_date.description: Only stays that check out on or after this date.

end_date.description: Only stays that check in on or before this date.

booked_start_date.description: Only reservations booked on or after this date (UTC).

booked_end_date.description: Only reservations booked on or before this date (UTC).

tools.name: beyondpricing_set_base_price
tools.title: Set a listing's base price
tools.description: WRITE: set the nightly base price of one listing, the anchor Beyond's pricing works around. This changes live prices on the channels. Minimum 10 in the listing's currency. PATCH /api/v1/listings/{id}/customizations/base-price/.

base_price.description: New nightly base price, at least 10, in the listing's currency.

tools.name: beyondpricing_set_listing_activation
tools.title: Turn price syncing on or off
tools.description: WRITE: enable or disable Beyond's price syncing for one listing. Turning it on starts pricing the listing live on its channels. When enabling a listing without a base price, base_price is required (minimum 10). base_price and min_price (minimum 5) are optional. PATCH /api/v1/listings/{id}/activation/.

enabled.description: true to start price syncing, false to stop it.

base_price.description: Base price to apply with the change, at least 10.

min_price.description: Minimum nightly price to apply with the change, at least 5.

annotations.title: Turn price syncing on or off

prompts.title: Get started with Beyond Pricing
prompts.description: What you can do with Beyond Pricing here, with example requests to try.
